title: P-256 sigma rho: metered branchy corrections, blinded prefix chain, register-resident forward block, 2^20-walk batches, flag-carry finishes, eight-copy loops, implicit previous key, small-key adders, checkpoint-only cycles, deferred inv test, paired reduction words, y3 fold with y-window adders

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1 (extended to the small-key y-window adder table), M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail, with the fold model for dy) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.789581 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. The walk is the predecessor's (A=2^24, K=2^32, theta=2^-60, residual Markov factor 400000) with tau=0.4943092 and batches of 2^20 walks. Every adder is redrawn from fresh coins until its Montgomery x is below 2^231 and its Montgomery y Y satisfies |2Y-p| <= p>>7 (at most 2^40 trials, worst case charged; a 2-D character-sum count with Bombieri's bound gives at least 2^224-2^160-3 accepted points, so failure stays below 2^-345); the batch forms D=x(W)-x(R) and t=x3-x(W). Each Montgomery round's multiple of p3 is one mul/umulh against p3 and adjacent rounds' shifted words share one extr (21 fewer instructions per backward block step, 4 per forward step, every value, carry and branch unchanged). Cycle detection is checkpoint-only: the 64-round anchor filter catches every cycle of length 2..64, a two-cycle escaping at the next anchor as a charged anchor check, epsilon=196/A+288/A^2+768/A^3. The backward block stores y3 or p-y3 (|y3'-y(W)|, or y3 at a top-limb tie) with the operand order chosen by a top-limb compare, so walk classes, keys and events are unchanged (each stored point is the old one or its negation) and y3's fix-up runs only at a top-limb tie. Every conditional field correction is a forward branch whose taken fix-up adds its exact extra instructions to a run-wide meter capped after every round at n*CORR+LAMBDA_CAP, CORR=13.959715 per step (inv's finish carry-only with its canonical test r3>=p3 deferred to the step tail's rare-event branch: carry weight 5, slow test 11; D and the second x3 subtraction below 2^231/p for every adder, pad 0; dy at most 1/4+2^-16 given any history up to two steps back under the fold model, plus a 2^-10 pad; the y3 tie 2^-24; other sites 2^-10 pads). Each global round blinds every batch's prefix chain with one fresh uniform unit rho (charged); the cap's abort probability uses only the algorithm's own coins (per-trail Azuma-Hoeffding with the average premise H-trail, Hoeffding over blinding noise), DELTA_CORR<5.07e-14, and the work bound holds regardless. The fixed path is charged 629,710,511 instructions per 2^20-walk plain round, the paired-reduction revision's 627,613,361 plus the fold's 2(2^20-1) (emulated executed-instruction counts of organizer-image builds: 629,710,483 on clean rounds of both input sets against 627,613,333; +131,070 per 2^16-walk plain and anchor round on input set 1; each batch exit, which canonicalises inv, charged 10 more; plus 1,024 per round), anchor rounds 4*(2^20-1)+9 more, so C_COMMON=600.604538 and the step charge is 614.650398 against the predecessor's 714.759990. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. Peak memory is below 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^81.961192 units, nonuniform advice zero, and the conditional success margin at least 5e-7 above 0.39 (5.557e-7 at tau=0.4943092; accidental adder-logarithm relations bounded over the accepted set of size at least 2^224-2^160-3, DELTA_CUT 2.5144e-7). Production probability and universal instruction bounds remain heuristic premises, not certifications; measurements and finite experiments keep their original scope and attribution.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure, with checkpoint-only cycle detection and the small-key adder key rule at toy scale (adder_key_shift 2: adders redrawn until key < p>>2; shift 4 exceeded the runner's time limit; no y window), at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
